title: Rabbi Buta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar Chadash, section “Let us make man”: Rabbi Yitzchak said, “Leave Rabbi Buta, who has made his dwelling with the masters of the Mishnah,” etc.

notes.text: The Zohar Chadash occurrence in the section “Let us make man” has no matching named passage in the returned evidence. The citation and Rabbi Buta’s identification remain unverified; no absence from the whole work is asserted.

The Zohar Chadash’s Midrash HaNe’elam on Genesis 1:26 contains this exchange. The Pritzker edition’s Aramaic text for volume 10, page 151, preserves Yitzchak’s remark. Buta then replies that he has not earned a dwelling with the masters of the Mishnah and goes on to report their question and an answer from Rabbi Bo. The passage attests Buta as a speaker in this narrative.
